summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the SPARQL plugin. Changes: sparql.py adds the Update(prologue, algebra) class beside Query; algebra.py translateUpdate always returns an Update, building the prologue from the single declaration group before the empty-request exit; update.py evalUpdate iterates update.algebra; processor.py adds prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) with _original_args recorded; __init__.py exports prepareUpdate. Added test/test_sparql_prepare.py with 11 tests. Nothing was run, so tests and DAWG update tests are unverified; the test file was hand-formatted to black, not checked with black. Nothing committed.
